prompt: Evaluate this repository's hygiene (CODEOWNERS, README, CONTRIBUTING, editorconfig) and report findings with a score. Do not change anything.
setup: The repository has source files but no CODEOWNERS in the root, .github/, or docs/.
There is no README file at the repository root.
There is no CONTRIBUTING file in the root, .github/, or docs/.
There is no .editorconfig at the repository root.
expected: The report lists the missing CODEOWNERS (setup-codeowners), missing README (setup-readme), missing CONTRIBUTING (setup-contributing), and missing .editorconfig (setup-editorconfig).
A maturity score is shown as a percentage with the failing and relevant weight totals.
Findings are ordered by priority and kept separate from the score.
setup-editorconfig is offered as a fix only, not applied.
must_not: Modify any file or Git state during evaluation.
Create a CODEOWNERS, README, CONTRIBUTING, or .editorconfig file.
Report a rule as passing that could not be evaluated.
